summary: Black Friday week is starting, and collectors are bracing for Target raffles and Costco Pokémon 30th drops after bots wrecked the last queue. The Pokémon Company announced changes to how new sets release, starting with Flowing Fists. On the onchain side, DefiLlama data shared by @0x_trophy shows Collector Crypt, Courtyard and Phygitals volume down 43% in early November, while new rivals keep arriving (Deadstock backed by a big Japanese oripa shop, Oripa, Renaiss via Binance Wallet). Solflare Packs mentions were small and positive, mostly from ambassadors.

top_posts.text:
How big can repacks get? 

Onchain data offers one answer.

@Collector_Crypt, @Courtyard_io and @phygitals averaged $11.0M daily in October, per @DefiLlama. 

November's first 20 days ran at $6.2M, down 43%.

Courtyard fell hardest: $3.3M became $1.5M https://t.co/9ImYoF0taG https://t.co/mRvKF4orJU
top_posts.why_it_matters: Repack volume across Collector Crypt, Courtyard and Phygitals fell 43% in November's first 20 days vs October (per DefiLlama). Market is cooling, so retention matters more than new hype.

top_posts.text:
Japan's biggest oripa platform is backing a startup that puts Pokemon cards onchain.

Dom (@domidom88), co-founder of Deadstock (@deadstock_app), says every token is backed one to one by a graded card in a vault in Tokyo. His partner JTCC, which he calls Japan's largest oripa https://t.co/Deo2PScOnQ
top_posts.why_it_matters: Deadstock puts vaulted Pokémon cards onchain with backing from a big Japanese oripa shop. Another supply source outside Collector Crypt.

top_posts.text:
A $100 card pulled from a 90% @Collector_Crypt machine sells back to it for $90 in USDC within seconds. An eBay sale leaves $86.35 before shipping. Rival pack seller Courtyard pays $84.60 for the same card.

Collector Crypt Q3 Benchmark, web and PDF: https://t.co/opUvspSJDj https://t.co/a79psTz9r7
top_posts.why_it_matters: Alea compares a 90% Collector Crypt buyback with eBay and Courtyard payouts on a $100 card. Clear, plain framing of the sell-back benefit we can use internally.

competitor_news.headline: Onchain repack volume averaged $11.0M/day in October and $6.2M/day in Nov 1-20, down 43%, per DefiLlama (shared by @0x_trophy). Courtyard fell from $3.3M to $1.5M.
Deadstock puts Pokémon cards onchain, each token backed 1:1 by a graded card vaulted in Tokyo, with backing from JTCC (called Japan's largest oripa by the co-founder).
Binance Wallet's gold Pokémon pack tease is run by Renaiss (BNB Chain); 508 wallets spent $658K, per @0x_trophy.
PayBox claims 575K+ users and 1.2M+ transactions in 100 days, and lets people open Collector Crypt packs from AI chats.
Oripa is minting early bird badges ahead of onchain Pokémon pack rips: early access Nov 26, open access Dec 2.
Courtyard is giving free Pokémon packs for daily check-in points. KYC is needed to withdraw USDC.
Gacha Times No. 17: Logan Paul giving away $50K in boxes via Ripit, Tilt's $100 F1 'Full Throttle' packs, Beezie Points Shop.

sources_note: Searched X via the x connector's full-archive search (relevancy) for 2026-11-22 09:05 to 2026-11-23 09:10 UTC, 17 queries covering pack openings, breaks, Collector Crypt/Courtyard/Phygitals/Watch.fun/Top Shot/Pinnacle/Rip.fun/Arena Club, onchain gacha, Solflare, grading/fakes, retail sell-outs and payments.
